title: SLIME DOGS at Harmony Hall
summary: Come party with the Slime Dogs as they take over one of the coolest venues around — Harmony Hall — and kick off the holiday season early!
description: Slime Dogs bring the party to Harmony Hall Fri Nov 21! All Ages | $20 Adv / $25 Door | Kids under 12 FREE! FRIDAY NOV 21 | SLIME DOGS LIVE @ HARMONY HALL Come party with the Slime Dogs as they take over one of the coolest venues around — Harmony Hall — and kick off the holiday season early! 🎶 Toronto’s Favourite Party Rock Band is bringing the energy — get ready to dance the night away! 📍 Harmony Hall – 14663 Woodbine Ave, Gormley, ON (just east of the 404 & 1km north of Bloomington) 👨‍👩‍👧 All Ages Show! 💸 Tickets: $20 Advance | $25 Door 🎟 Kids under 12 are FREE (…as long as they buy the band a beer 😉🍺) Don’t miss this night of pure party rock energy! Grab your tickets now and let’s make it a night to remember.
